name: dlead-pre-wire-plan
description: Builds a Pre-Wire Plan with who to see one to one before a design review, what each person needs to hear and might object to, the question to ask each, an objection log fed into the deck and the fallback if someone says no. Use for "run dlead-pre-wire-plan", "pre-wire the review", "who should I talk to before the meeting", "no surprises in the review", "align stakeholders before the presentation", "nemawashi for design", "the big review is next week", "get buy-in before the room", part of the Claude for Design Leaders Pack by 90n.
